objective: Run as many REAL independent, documented, low-cost agent research jobs as allowed by accessible free hosting, without inventing billions of active workers or spending money.
priority: Increase successful model/source calls and individual deliverables from already configured GitHub jobs before adding new provider deployments.

providers.name: GitHub Actions standard hosted runners
providers.free_conditions: Standard GitHub-hosted runners free on public repositories, subject to usage/policy limits
providers.best_for: Scheduled public-source research, rotating role workloads, audited per-agent Markdown documents and persistent short-lived artifacts
providers.resource_notes: Current repo uses 30 primary matrix jobs, max-parallel 10, one-hourly schedule with 2/50 workers per manager. S/G/H are bounded rotated inferences, not billions of concurrent AIs.
providers.required_action: Watch scheduled runs and audit failures before increasing batches; avoid simultaneous push-triggered cancellation storms.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers Free
providers.free_conditions: 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU time per request, 128 MB memory; free plan limits subject to change
providers.best_for: Very lightweight public API polling, URL checks, dispatch and coordination; not full language-model inference
providers.required_action: Owner must connect an authenticated Cloudflare account and approve any deployment; no credentials exist in this workflow.

providers.name: Hugging Face Spaces
providers.free_conditions: Free static Spaces; CPU Basic no-hourly-cost may require paid account to create Gradio/Docker compute Space and free hardware sleeps when idle
providers.best_for: Front end and visual reporting; optional small AI demos only if account is eligible
providers.required_action: Do not deploy until authenticated write permission and zero-charge eligibility confirmed.

providers.name: Hugging Face Jobs
providers.free_conditions: Jobs billed per minute: CPU Basic listed as $0.01/hr; prepaid credits or positive balance required
providers.best_for: Explicitly paid optional compute only, not authorized for free-only goal
providers.required_action: Do not run jobs or schedule work when a free-only instruction applies.

providers.name: Google Cloud Run
providers.free_conditions: Monthly CPU/RAM/request allowances with billable excess; may require billing account
providers.best_for: Occasional short containers after connection and strict budget guardrails
providers.required_action: Obtain authenticated account, billing consent, zero-dollar spend guardrail and explicit deployment permission.

providers.name: Render
providers.free_conditions: Verify currently available free workspace/service tier and sleep behavior before any deployment
providers.best_for: Small dashboard or API for viewing agent results rather than always-on AI inference
providers.required_action: User can connect Render integration; installation alone does not deploy services.

activation_strategy.current: Keep existing GitHub Actions hourly autonomous cycles; rotating 30 primary jobs plus manager/worker tasks and bounded descendant model checks.
activation_strategy.no_fake_scaling: Do not claim 375,188,632,680 defined worker IDs can be hosted for free or are all concurrently active.
priority_measures: Unique role IDs with actual model_completed reports
Independent new original-source checks across unrelated websites
Individual Markdown deliverables from actually attempted agents
Independently verified cryptocurrency credited to owner-approved addresses
expansion_order: Verify present GitHub Actions workflow runs and missing reports
Tune source calls and realistic model/compute quota without breaking existing paid research
Connect new free provider only if it provides measurable extra capacity
Deploy a lightweight job/site checker with clear output evidence, not a fake ChatGPT clone
activation_strategy.financial_safety: No charges, prepaid credits, billing enrollment or subscriptions without explicit owner authorization. Never use private keys/wallets in hosted code.
